ns2:course.label: Special Topics in Finance
ns2:course.description: Lectures and discussions relating to new areas of interest. See class schedule for topics and prerequisites. 1 to 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. May be repeated in the same term or subsequent terms to a maximum of 3 undergraduate hours or 4 graduate hours. Credit is not given for FIN 490 CRNs 57268 and 57353 and FIN 464. Course will not satisfy Finance major requirements. Prerequisite: FIN 300 or consent of instructor.
